ContentElementId.title: Content element id
ContentElementId.description: Element identifier. Any non-empty string except the reserved literal `__page_context_root__`, strings PHP casts to integers (`0`, `12`, `-3`), and strings carrying a line terminator (U+000A, U+000D, U+2028, U+2029); all are rejected with `400`. The id is stored verbatim, so an author-supplied id such as `hero` names that element instance and is as valid as a generated hex id. An integer-castable id is refused because it would turn the string-keyed per-element maps of a response into JSON lists.
